issues.description: Function signature mismatch for make_y_state: the problem statement (problem_statement.md line 79) and the reference solution (solution_repository/msd.py line 95) specify make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None (i.e., the function must accept a depolarization probability p). The template stub (template_repository/msd.py line 41) declares make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int) -> None and omits the p parameter. This mismatch will confuse students and cause tests that call make_y_state with three arguments (circ, q, p) to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template stub signature to include the depolarization probability parameter: def make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None:, and update the docstring to document the p parameter. Ensure any references/tests use the same signature.
